issues.detail: The Greek 'ως παντα' (as always) is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.

The Greek phrase 'της θειας δυναμεως αυτου' (of His divine power) is rendered as 'Quyền năng thiêng liêng của Ngài', but the Vietnamese structure implies the power *gave* the gifts, whereas the Greek indicates the gifts were *given to us by/through* His divine power ('...της θειας δυναμεως αυτου τα... δεδωρημενης').
